## About

I'm a data analyst with an M.A. in Mathematics and an M.S. in Business from the University of Wisconsin-Madison. I work primarily in R, with growing experience in Python, SQL, Power BI, and Tableau.

This site collects analytical projects using public data, built with reproducible tools: R, Quarto, and Git/GitHub.

## Project Areas

- **[Finance](finance/index.qmd)** — El Cerrito municipal finance: credit rating, audits, borrowing, and tax collections
- **[Library](library/index.qmd)** — El Cerrito library issue: history, Measure C, Task Force, cost disclosures, and key votes
- **[Transportation](transportation/index.qmd)** — Richmond Street bike lanes, San Pablo Avenue, Ohlone Greenway, and parking management
- **[Studies](studies/index.qmd)** — the Service Delivery and Compensation studies, and the sequencing problem between them
